description: This file defines the LabelInfo class which manages label data such as label key, comments, file location, and locale-specific label values within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods to get and set label values and comments, and tracks multiple locale-specific labels.

classes.name: LabelInfo
classes.description: Represents label information including key, comments, filename, and locale-specific label values, with methods to manipulate and retrieve this data.

methods.name: getLabelKeyComment
methods.description: Returns the comment associated with the label key.

methods.name: setLabelKeyComment
methods.description: Sets the comment for the label key.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Returns the filename associated with the label.

methods.name: getLabelValue
methods.description: Retrieves the LabelValue object for a given locale string.

methods.name: getLabelValueSize
methods.description: Returns the number of locale-specific label values.

methods.name: setLabelValue
methods.description: Creates or updates the label value for a specified locale; can also remove the locale if labelValue is empty and update is true.
